claim: Let \(M_8\) be the Wagner graph, with vertex set \(\mathbb Z/8\mathbb Z\), cycle edges \(\{i,i+1\}\), and antipodal edges \(\{i,i+4\}\). Let \(\operatorname{Match}(M_8)\) be the ordinary matching complex whose faces are matchings of \(M_8\). Then \[\operatorname{Match}(M_8)\simeq \bigvee^{6}S^2.\]
integrity: The graph, all matching faces, all Hasse covers, the complete discrete-Morse matching, its acyclicity, and an independent mod-2 homology calculation are reconstructed by the accompanying verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the eight-vertex Möbius ladder and does not give an all-parameter formula.

The full text of arXiv:2608.30601 was inaccessible through the available lawful routes during this check; its title and abstract explicitly concern independence and perfect matching complexes, not the ordinary matching complex. Unindexed literature may remain.
title: The Wagner-graph matching complex is \(\bigvee^{6}S^2\)
